answer: The vine register is checked at draw time, yarrow lists the eligible set, and vertex seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 49 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 49 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 9 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
